turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Uncle, it's me, your nephew Rahul. I'm in big trouble.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I had an accident and I'm at the hospital. They need 50,000 rupees for surgery right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't tell papa. He has a heart condition and this will kill him.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Send the money to this UPI ID immediately. My phone is about to die.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, I'm scared. This is between you and me only.
